title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-016
doc_notes: This document is a Record of Facility Operation log from the Anchorage ARTCC detailing routine air traffic control operations and the JAL 1628 incident.

incidents.summary: Japan Airlines flight 1628 reported an unidentified target pacing the aircraft at FL350, observed visually and via radar.
incidents.quote: JL1628, HB747, BIKF ANC reported traffic at his altitude (FL350) one mile with a white and yellow strobe
